# Distinct item coverage

<!-- Generated by npm run research:build; do not hand-edit counts. -->

Client 6785; eligibility evaluated 2026-10-16. 42/42 heroes have at least two distinct eligible item options.

Counts combine reviewed scenarios and stages. Repeating an item in another stage, problem or goal does not add an option. Two options overall does not promise two for every player, stage, budget, inventory or response window. Expired or changed evidence can reduce the count.

## Next research loop

Build-color target: at least one green (Vitality), or both purple (Spirit) and orange (Weapon). 42/42 meet this target. Category coverage is across reviewed scenarios/stages; it does not establish universal suitability or override player-delivery conditions.

No heroes are below the two-item or build-color targets. Next work is scenario depth and practical interaction testing.
